subject: New claim - workplace injury 12 August
body: I want to start a claim about an injury at work on 12 August 2026. I slipped on an unmarked wet floor in the loading bay and hurt my lower back. I was signed off for nine days. My employer is Fenwick Logistics Ltd. You can reach me on peter.alderton@example.co.uk or 07700 900412. My NI number is QQ 12 34 56 C.

subject: Further evidence for existing claim
body: Please add the attached occupational health report to my existing file. Nothing else has changed. Marguerite Oyelaran, 14 Selby Rise, BL3 2QF.

subject: Starting a claim
body: I would like to make a claim following an accident on site. I do not have a reference number yet as this is the first time I have contacted you. Contact: solveig.r@example.org

subject: Following up on my case again
body: This is the fourth time I have written. Nobody has called me back since 4 June and the last person I spoke to promised a decision within ten working days. I am not asking for an update any more, I am telling you that the way this has been handled is not acceptable and I want it looked at by someone senior.

subject: Call note - claimant distressed
body: Claimant rang. Her husband died three weeks ago and he was the one who had been dealing with all of the correspondence. She became very distressed on the call and said she is not sleeping and cannot face the paperwork. She asked whether the claim would be closed if she did not reply by the date on the letter.

subject: Enquiry about a boiler warranty
body: I am writing about the warranty on the boiler installed at my property in March. The installer gave me this address. I would like the thermostat replaced under the five year guarantee.

subject: Response deadline
body: Your letter says I must respond by 05/03/2026 but the letter is dated 2 September 2026. Which is it? I do not want to lose the claim over a typing error.

subject: Update on my file
body: Jane said on the phone that the assessment had already been booked, but the letter I received afterwards says it has not. I would like someone to confirm which is correct before I take a day off work for it.

subject: Documents as requested
body: As requested, please find attached the wage slips for the three months before the accident, plus the letter from my GP.

subject: I want to stop the claim
body: I have thought about it and I want to withdraw the claim completely. Please close the file and do not contact me again about it.
